messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: New testing framework
parts:
Rob has been talking about implementing a new testing framework which will make:
1) developing new functions easier to test
2) make our existing functions more robust by making it easier to test boundary conditions
3) cleaning up a lot of existing test code.

Seth, if you're still thinking about implementing kronecker utilities, you should help out on this effort. It'll make your life easier in the long run.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] New testing framework
parts:
We didn't get a chance to discuss the testing framework; the meeting was pretty long and it seemed like people were losing steam, so I didn't share what I had worked out so far (which isn't much). Check out this wiki: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Testing-framework

We need to flesh the framework out more, especially for matrix arguments, given that this is where I think we'll likely see the most leverage in migrating to a new framework.


Rob
